create_Gemma3nProcessor: create a Gemma3nProcessor instance with feature_extractor, image_processor, and tokenizer for multimodal input processing
call_Gemma3nProcessor_with_text_images_a: call Gemma3nProcessor with text, images, and audio inputs to produce tokenized BatchFeature output with token_type_ids
call_Gemma3nProcessor_with_audio_only: call Gemma3nProcessor with audio inputs to expand placeholder audio tokens into full audio sequences
call_Gemma3nProcessor_with_images_only: call Gemma3nProcessor with image inputs to expand placeholder image tokens into full image sequences
get_Gemma3nProcessor_model_input_names: get Gemma3nProcessor model_input_names property listing all tokenizer, image processor, and audio processor input names
